title: Round Display Pod
tagline: A round, minimal-bezel instrument pod for a 1.28" ESP32 display.
summary: A compact round enclosure for the ESP32-2424S012 ("Electrobot ESP32-C3 1.28in") display with its own battery. It has a bonded polycarbonate lens, a sealed rear cover and a three-lug quick-release bayonet: push in, twist 30°, click. It clamps to any round motorcycle handlebar, and every dimension is adjustable for your board, battery and bike.
status: version 4 prototype. It has not been fit-tested, vibration-tested or water-tested, and several dimensions are still estimates. Print the bayonet fit test first, and don't use it on the road until it passes the checks in the assembly guide.
see_sub: Renders from the OpenSCAD model. The pod is 45 mm across the front and 20 mm deep, with a 4 mm ring around the lens.

housing.name: Housing
housing.what: Part A: front shell and side wall. The lens bonds into its front; no front screws
housing.material: PETG for the prototype, ASA final. Rear face on the bed, no supports

rear_cover.name: Rear cover
rear_cover.what: Part B: battery bay, gasket seat and the male bayonet
rear_cover.material: ASA or PETG. Gasket face on the bed

board_retainer.name: Board retainer
board_retainer.what: Holds the display board forward on a foam pad, and separates it from the battery

receiver.name: Bayonet receiver
receiver.what: Part C: the twist-lock socket with L-shaped tracks and the ball-plunger detent

clamp_upper.name: Clamp, upper
clamp_upper.what: Part D: handlebar clamp with the tilted receiver cup
clamp_upper.material: ASA or PETG. Supports from the build plate only

clamp_lower.name: Clamp, lower
clamp_lower.what: Part D: handlebar clamp, lower half

cover_gasket.name: Cover gasket
cover_gasket.what: Seals the rear cover (or cut it from 1 mm silicone sheet with the DXF)

bayonet_test_male.name: Bayonet fit test
bayonet_test_male.what: Print this and the receiver first, to tune the bayonet's fit

dxf.lens: The 36.2 mm x 1 mm polycarbonate lens
dxf.display_gasket: 0.5 mm foam ring behind the lens ledge
dxf.cover_gasket: Cover gasket, for cutting from 1 mm silicone or EPDM sheet
dxf.retainer_foam: 1.5 mm foam pad for the board retainer
